Column 2: Notes

Column 2: The Faculty Senate meets monthly in September-May. These final approval dates by the Faculty Senate for the term indicated at the top of the column. Course modification dates are set by the start of enrollment for each respective term, as a course cannot change once a student has already enrolled. New course dates are set by the start of each term. A new course can be added to the catalog up until the day classes begin. Sometime, Faculty Senate curriculum committees meet during the summer months. This is not guarenteed, so it is suggested to use the above dates as guidelines. Courses are reviewed by the department curriculum committees and chairs, the college curriculum committees and deans, the Faculty Senate curriculum committees, and then are voted on by the members of the Faculty Senate. The Faculty Senate committees meet once a month, typically two weeks prior to the Senate meetings. Departmental and College-level curriculum committees' meeting schedules vary. Please contact your department chair or college curriculum committee chair to learn when they meet.

Column 2: *Temporary courses do not require approval by the Faculty Senate. Once they are approved by the Curriculum & Standards Committee, and/or the Graduate Council, they can be entered into eCampus.
